text:
maya singh: heads up — intermittent reconnect spikes for tenant=acme around 12:00 UTC, looks correlated to proxy keepalive churn. console shows duplicate session counts :thinking_face:
raj patel: timeline? client or gateway side? any 5xx or 204s?
maya singh: started ~11:58, lasted ~6m. no 5xx, lots of 204 then resume attempts. sample logs below.
Olga B.: pasted grep from proxy logs:
[2024-03-12T11:58:12Z] proxy: tenant=acme session=abc123 keepalive_miss=1 route=us-east-1
[2024-03-12T11:58:12Z] proxy: tenant=acme session=abc123 proxied_status=204 resume_allowed=false
[2024-03-12T11:58:12Z] client: tenant=acme session=abc123 reconnect start=1
raj patel: proxied_status=204 + resume_allowed=false => client will open fresh session and we bill again. that matches console spike.
maya singh: we changed keepalive ttl in proxy v2.14 (30s->15s) last week. likely too aggressive for noisy mobile.
devex-liz: can we avoid forcing fresh reconnects when a resume would work?
raj patel: probable race: proxy GC runs before router emits resume header. fix options: extend session_ttl or emit resume_allowed=true in a grace window.
Olga B.: proposed quick config for canary:
streaming.keepalive_interval: 30s
streaming.session_ttl: 60s
streaming.resume_grace: 10s
reconnect_backoff.initial_ms: 250
reconnect_backoff.max_ms: 8000
maya singh: need console telemetry labels: route_id, proxy_version, resume_allowed. current tenant-only grouping is noisy.
console-bot: created ENG-4287 to add those labels and stacked time series for resume_allowed vs fresh_reconnects.
raj patel: low-effort patch: set resume_allowed=true if session.touch_time > now-resume_grace and return 200+header instead of 204. small PR inbound.
Olga B.: PR #1042 created with header change + metric emit. applying to canary namespace.
sre-bot: Alert: streaming-reconnects-high (tenant=acme) rate 120/min triggered 2024-03-12T11:59:00Z
maya singh: please watch billing during canary. runbook: if billing delta >10% for tenant during canary, rollback and restore ttl=15s.
raj patel: I'll add unit+integration tests in router/proxy to simulate chunk stall. ETA EOD.
devex-liz: I'll draft rollout notes with ops steps to toggle per-route and revert. include pointers to ENG-4287 dashboard.
Olga B.: monitoring canary logs, will report back in ~20m.
maya singh: thanks — tagging @sre-oncall to keep an eye. :thumbsup:
